edges.reason: Basalt pillars are part of the gray stained glass tower; player must locate the tower to find mineable basalt
Polished granite slabs form the tower floor/roof; player must find the glass tower to access the slabs
Mossy stone brick stairs are inside the enclosed room; spruce trapdoor marks the only entrance
The lime bed is inside the enclosed stone brick room accessed through the spruce trapdoor entrance
Jack_o_lantern marks the pumpkin farm with farmland and water; player must find it to locate plantable farmland
Bee nest is attached to the only birch tree in the scene; finding it locates the birch logs needed for crafting
Mined basalt blocks are the primary building material for constructing the wall
Polished granite slabs serve as the top cap layer of the wall structure
Mossy stone brick stairs are incorporated as decorative elements in the wall
Completing all mining tasks in the room before building ensures systematic task progression
The birch door is placed as the wall's entrance gate, completing the wall structure

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The gray stained glass blocks are at spawn-relative (15,3-4,2-3). Player must navigate to within 6 blocks and face the tower. The tower is ~15 blocks east of spawn, so max_distance=6 forces actual navigation (player must walk at least 9 blocks). Facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking toward the glass.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The jack_o_lantern is at spawn-relative (-13,1,5), approximately 13 blocks west of spawn. Max_distance=6 forces the player to walk at least 7 blocks toward the farm. Facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking at the lantern.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce trapdoor is at spawn-relative (-2,3,-13) above the room entrance, approximately 14 blocks north of spawn. Max_distance=6 forces the player to navigate to the room entrance. Facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking at the trapdoor.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The bee nest is at spawn-relative (4,3,14) on the east face of the birch tree, approximately 14 blocks south of spawn. Max_distance=6 forces the player to walk to the tree. Facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking at the nest.

Uses inventory_has because mining basalt with a pickaxe drops basalt as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. Basalt is not in the player's starting inventory. The player mines from the tower pillars at (14/16, y2-4, z2-3).

Uses inventory_has because mining a polished granite slab with a pickaxe drops it as an item into the player's inventory. Not in starting inventory. The slabs are at the tower floor (y=1) and roof (y=5).

Uses inventory_has because mining mossy stone brick stairs with a pickaxe drops the item into the player's inventory. Not in starting inventory. The stairs are inside the spruce trapdoor room at (-3,1,-15), (-1,1,-15), and (-1,1,-14).

Uses inventory_has because breaking a bed drops the colored bed item into the player's inventory. In Java Edition, lime beds drop as 'lime_bed'. Not in starting inventory. The bed is inside the trapdoor room with foot at (-2,1,-14) and head at (-2,1,-15).

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block, object=pumpkin_stem) because planting pumpkin seeds on farmland creates a pumpkin_stem block at y=1 (on top of farmland at y=0). Box tightly covers the farm area at x=-14/-12, z=2-4 with ±1 margin. Checking y=1-2 where stems appear above farmland.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a birch door results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player has 6 birch_planks in starting inventory and a crafting table at (1,0,1). The 2x3 recipe produces 3 birch doors; checking for at least 1. Birch_door is not in starting inventory.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block, object=basalt) because basalt is the primary wall material per the dependency graph. The wall building area is at spawn-relative (5-9, y=0, z=6). Box [3,1,4] to [11,5,8] generously covers the platform area with ±2 margin, checking y=1-5 for placed blocks above the platform. Min_count=5 ensures a meaningful wall structure (e.g., 5 blocks tall or 5 blocks wide). This box does NOT overlap with the existing basalt tower at x=14-16.

scene_description: A multi-landmark exploration and building benchmark with four distinct structures placed 13-16 blocks from spawn in cardinal directions: (1) EAST - Gray stained glass tower with basalt pillars and polished granite slab floor/roof on a stone foundation, (2) NORTH - Enclosed stone brick room with spruce trapdoor entrance containing a lime bed and mossy stone brick stairs, (3) WEST - Pumpkin farm with underground water source, farmland, and jack_o_lantern marker, (4) SOUTH - Birch tree with bee nest. A crafting table and wall building area with guidance signs are near center. The player must find all landmarks, mine specific blocks, plant pumpkin seeds, craft a birch door, and build a wall combining all gathered materials.
task_text: Explore this area to find four landmarks: a gray stained glass tower to the east, a jack_o_lantern farm marker to the west, a spruce trapdoor room to the north, and a bee nest on a birch tree to the south. Mine basalt and polished granite slabs from the tower. Mine mossy stone brick stairs and the lime bed from inside the trapdoor room. Plant pumpkin seeds at the farm. Craft a birch door using the crafting table. Finally, build a wall (at least 5 blocks) at the marked building area using basalt, polished granite slabs, mossy stone brick stairs, and place the birch door as a gate.
design_notes: FINAL APPROVED LAYOUT. Spawn at origin (0,0,0). All structures 13-16 blocks from spawn requiring meaningful navigation. EAST TOWER (~14-16, y0-5, z2-3): Stone foundation y=0, polished granite slab floor y=1 (6 slabs), basalt pillars at 4 corners y=2-4 (12 basalt blocks), gray stained glass center y=3-4 (4 blocks), polished granite slab roof y=5 (6 slabs). NORTH ROOM (~-4 to 0, y0-3, z-16 to -13): Enclosed stone brick room, 2-block doorway at ~-2,1-2,-13, spruce trapdoor at ~-2,3,-13. Interior: 3 mossy stairs at (-3,1,-15), (-1,1,-15), (-1,1,-14); lime bed foot at (-2,1,-14) head at (-2,1,-15). WEST FARM (~-14 to -12, y-1 to 1, z2-5): Dirt foundation at y=-1, water source at (-13,-1,3), dirt layer at y=0 with farmland at x=-14 and x=-12, air hole at (-13,0,3) above water for hydration visibility, jack_o_lantern at (-13,1,5). SOUTH TREE (~3, y0-5, z14): 5-block birch trunk, leaf canopy at y=4-5, bee nest at (4,3,14). CENTER: Crafting table at (1,0,1). WALL AREA: Smooth stone platform at (5-9,0,6). Player inventory: diamond pickaxe, diamond axe, diamond hoe, 4 pumpkin seeds, 6 birch planks.
